# truenas_iscsi_extent (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS iSCSI extent by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) iSCSI extent name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `avail_threshold` (Number)
- `blocksize` (Number)
- `comment` (String)
- `disk` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `filesize` (Number)
- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI extent ID.

- `locked` (Boolean)
- `naa` (String)
- `path` (String)

- `product_id` (String)
